glosses: die Brust betreffend, zu ihr gehörig

translations.source_sense_description: Anatomie, Medizin: die Brust betreffend, zu ihr gehörig

glosses: Of or pertaining to the breast, or chest.

examples.text: Clad in red robes and a gold pectoral cross, Agostini finally lowered his gaze as he crossed the marble floor.

... footballers, fashionable Counsel, corrupt parliamentarians, glistening Under Secretaries from helpful Whitehall Ministries, Greek shipowners, cockney hairdressers, unlisted maharajahs, drunk magistrates, venal mayors, ruling princes of countries that have ceased to exist, prelates in suède boots and pectoral crosses...

glosses: Relating to, or good for, diseases of the chest or lungs.

examples.text: But, in general, a few days' confinement, abstinence from flesh meat, and frequent sippings of some tepid pectoral drink, sufficed for the cure.

glosses: Protective armor for a horse's breast.

examples.text: The Poitrinal, Pectoral, or Breast Plate was formed of plates of metal rivetted together, which covered the breast and shoulders of the horse, it was commonly adorned with foliage, or other ornaments engraved or embossed.

glosses: A covering or protection for the breast.
A breastplate, especially that worn by the Jewish high priest.
A clasp, cross, or ornamental square of cloth etc. worn upon the breast.
An ancient Egyptian item of jewelry worn upon the chest, often part of (or constituting) a necklace or collar.
A medicine for diseases of the chest organs, especially the lungs.
